112: 			printf("(%lu) read response from nvdla: %08x\n", ticks, dla->nvdla2csb_data);
113: 			
114: 			if ((dla->nvdla2csb_data & op.mask) != (op.data & op.mask)) {
115: 				op.reading = 0;
116: 				op.tries--;
117: 				printf("(%lu) invalid response -- trying again\n", ticks);
118: 				if (!op.tries) {
119: 					printf("(%lu) ERROR: timed out reading response\n", ticks);
120: 					_test_passed = 0;
121: 					opq.pop();
122: 				}
123: 			} else
124: 				opq.pop();
125: 		}
126: 		
127: 		if (!op.write && op.reading)
128: 			return 0;
129: 		
130: 		if (noop)
131: 			return 0;
132: 		
133: 		if (!dla->csb2nvdla_ready) {
134: 			printf("(%lu) CSB stalled...\n", ticks);
135: 			return 0;
136: 		}
137: 		
138: 		if (op.write) {
139: 			dla->csb2nvdla_valid = 1;
140: 			dla->csb2nvdla_addr = op.addr;
141: 			dla->csb2nvdla_wdat = op.data;
142: 			dla->csb2nvdla_write = 1;
143: 			dla->csb2nvdla_nposted = 0;
144: 			printf("(%lu) write to nvdla: addr %08x, data %08x\n", ticks, op.addr, op.data);
145: 			opq.pop();
146: 		} else {
147: 			dla->csb2nvdla_valid = 1;
148: 			dla->csb2nvdla_addr = op.addr;
149: 			dla->csb2nvdla_write = 0;
150: 			printf("(%lu) read from nvdla: addr %08x\n", ticks, op.addr);
151: 			
152: 			op.reading = 1;
153: 		}
154: 		
155: 		return 0;
156: 	}
157: 	
158: 	bool done() {
159: 		return opq.empty();
160: 	}
161: 	
162: 	int test_passed() {
163: 		return _test_passed;
164: 	}
165: };

167: template <typename ADDRTYPE>
168: class AXIResponder {
169: public:
170: 	struct connections {
171: 		uint8_t *aw_awvalid;
172: 		uint8_t *aw_awready;
173: 		uint8_t *aw_awid;
174: 		uint8_t *aw_awlen;
175: 		ADDRTYPE *aw_awaddr;
176: 		
177: 		uint8_t *w_wvalid;
178: 		uint8_t *w_wready;
179: 		uint32_t *w_wdata;
180: 		uint64_t *w_wstrb;
181: 		uint8_t *w_wlast;
182: 		
183: 		uint8_t *b_bvalid;
184: 		uint8_t *b_bready;
185: 		uint8_t *b_bid;
186: 		
187: 		uint8_t *ar_arvalid;
188: 		uint8_t *ar_arready;
189: 		uint8_t *ar_arid;
190: 		uint8_t *ar_arlen;
191: 		ADDRTYPE *ar_araddr;
192: 		
193: 		uint8_t *r_rvalid;
194: 		uint8_t *r_rready;
195: 		uint8_t *r_rid;
196: 		uint8_t *r_rlast;
197: 		uint32_t *r_rdata;
198: 	};
199: 
200: private:
201: 
202: #define AXI_BLOCK_SIZE 4096
203: #define AXI_WIDTH 512
204: 
205: 	const static int AXI_R_LATENCY = 32;
206: 	const static int AXI_R_DELAY = 0;
207: 
208: 	struct axi_r_txn {
209: 		int rvalid;
210: 		int rlast;
211: 		uint32_t rdata[AXI_WIDTH / 32];
212: 		uint8_t rid;
213: 	};
214: 	std::queue<axi_r_txn> r_fifo;
215: 	std::queue<axi_r_txn> r0_fifo;
216: 	
217: 	struct axi_aw_txn {
218: 		uint8_t awid;
219: 		uint32_t awaddr;
220: 		uint8_t awlen;
221: 	};
222: 	std::queue<axi_aw_txn> aw_fifo;
223: 	
224: 	struct axi_w_txn {
225: 		uint32_t wdata[AXI_WIDTH / 32];
226: 		uint64_t wstrb;
227: 		uint8_t wlast;
228: 	};
229: 	std::queue<axi_w_txn> w_fifo;
230: 	
231: 	struct axi_b_txn {
232: 		uint8_t bid;
233: 	};
234: 	std::queue<axi_b_txn> b_fifo;
235: 	
236: 	std::map<uint32_t, std::vector<uint8_t> > ram;
237: 	
238: 	struct connections dla;
239: 	const char *name;
240: 	
241: public:	
242: 	AXIResponder(struct connections _dla, const char *_name) {
243: 		dla = _dla;
244: 		
245: 		*dla.aw_awready = 1;
246: 		*dla.w_wready = 1;
247: 		*dla.b_bvalid = 0;
248: 		*dla.ar_arready = 1;
249: 		*dla.r_rvalid = 0;
250: 		
251: 		name = _name;
252: 		
253: 		/* add some latency... */
254: 		for (int i = 0; i < AXI_R_LATENCY; i++) {
255: 			axi_r_txn txn;
256: 			
257: 			txn.rvalid = 0;
258: 			txn.rvalid = 0;
259: 			txn.rid = 0;
260: 			txn.rlast = 0;
261: 			for (int i = 0; i < AXI_WIDTH / 32; i++) {
262: 				txn.rdata[i] = 0xAAAAAAAA;
263: 			}
264: 			
265: 			r0_fifo.push(txn);
266: 		}
267: 	}
268: 
269: 	uint8_t read(uint32_t addr) {
270: 		ram[addr / AXI_BLOCK_SIZE].resize(AXI_BLOCK_SIZE, 0);
271: 		return ram[addr / AXI_BLOCK_SIZE][addr % AXI_BLOCK_SIZE];
272: 	}
273: 	
274: 	void write(uint32_t addr, uint8_t data) {
275: 		ram[addr / AXI_BLOCK_SIZE].resize(AXI_BLOCK_SIZE, 0);
276: 		ram[addr / AXI_BLOCK_SIZE][addr % AXI_BLOCK_SIZE] = data;
277: 	}
278: 	
279: 	void eval() {
280: 		/* write request */
281: 		if (*dla.aw_awvalid && *dla.aw_awready) {
282: 			printf("(%lu) %s: write request from dla, addr %08lx id %d\n", ticks, name, *dla.aw_awaddr, *dla.aw_awid);
283: 			
284: 			axi_aw_txn txn;
285: 			
286: 			txn.awid = *dla.aw_awid;
287: 			txn.awaddr = *dla.aw_awaddr & ~(ADDRTYPE)(AXI_WIDTH / 8 - 1);
288: 			txn.awlen = *dla.aw_awlen;
289: 			aw_fifo.push(txn);
290: 			
291: 			*dla.aw_awready = 0;
292: 		} else
293: 			*dla.aw_awready = 1;
294: 		
295: 		/* write data */
296: 		if (*dla.w_wvalid) {
297: 			printf("(%lu) %s: write data from dla (%08x %08x...)\n", ticks, name, dla.w_wdata[0], dla.w_wdata[1]);
298: 			
299: 			axi_w_txn txn;
300: 			
301: 			for (int i = 0; i < AXI_WIDTH / 32; i++)
302: 				txn.wdata[i] = dla.w_wdata[i];
303: 			txn.wstrb = *dla.w_wstrb;
304: 			txn.wlast = *dla.w_wlast;
305: 			w_fifo.push(txn);
306: 		}
307: 		
308: 		/* read request */
309: 		if (*dla.ar_arvalid && *dla.ar_arready) {
310: 			ADDRTYPE addr = *dla.ar_araddr & ~(ADDRTYPE)(AXI_WIDTH / 8 - 1);
311: 			uint8_t len = *dla.ar_arlen;
312: 
313: 			printf("(%lu) %s: read request from dla, addr %08lx burst %d id %d\n", ticks, name, *dla.ar_araddr, *dla.ar_arlen, *dla.ar_arid);
314: 			
315: 			do {
316: 				axi_r_txn txn;
317: 
318: 				txn.rvalid = 1;
319: 				txn.rlast = len == 0;
320: 				txn.rid = *dla.ar_arid;
321: 			
322: 				for (int i = 0; i < AXI_WIDTH / 32; i++) {
323: 					uint32_t da = read(addr + i * 4) + 
324: 					              (read(addr + i * 4 + 1) << 8) + 
325: 					              (read(addr + i * 4 + 2) << 16) + 
326: 					              (read(addr + i * 4 + 3) << 24);
327: 					txn.rdata[i] = da;
328: 				}
329: 
330: 				r_fifo.push(txn);
331: 				
332: 				addr += AXI_WIDTH / 8;
333: 			} while (len--);
334: 			
335: 			axi_r_txn txn;
336: 			
337: 			txn.rvalid = 0;
338: 			txn.rid = 0;
339: 			txn.rlast = 0;
340: 			for (int i = 0; i < AXI_WIDTH / 32; i++) {
341: 				txn.rdata[i] = 0x55555555;
342: 			}
343: 			
344: 			for (int i = 0; i < AXI_R_DELAY; i++)
345: 				r_fifo.push(txn);
346: 			
347: 			*dla.ar_arready = 0;
348: 		} else
349: 			*dla.ar_arready = 1;
350: 		
351: 		/* now handle the write FIFOs ... */
352: 		if (!aw_fifo.empty() && !w_fifo.empty()) {
353: 			axi_aw_txn &awtxn = aw_fifo.front();
354: 			axi_w_txn &wtxn = w_fifo.front();
355: 			
356: 			if (wtxn.wlast != (awtxn.awlen == 0)) {
357: 				printf("(%lu) %s: wlast / awlen mismatch\n", ticks, name);
358: 				abort();
359: 			}
360: 			
361: 			for (int i = 0; i < AXI_WIDTH / 8; i++) {
362: 				if (!((wtxn.wstrb >> i) & 1))
363: 					continue;
364: 				
365: 				write(awtxn.awaddr + i, (wtxn.wdata[i / 4] >> ((i % 4) * 8)) & 0xFF);
366: 			}
367: 			
368: 			
369: 			if (wtxn.wlast) {
370: 				printf("(%lu) %s: write, last tick\n", ticks, name);
371: 				aw_fifo.pop();
372: 
373: 				axi_b_txn btxn;
374: 				btxn.bid = awtxn.awid;
375: 				b_fifo.push(btxn);
376: 			} else {
377: 				printf("(%lu) %s: write, ticks remaining\n", ticks, name);
378: 
379: 				awtxn.awlen--;
380: 				awtxn.awaddr += AXI_WIDTH / 8;
381: 			}
382: 			
383: 			w_fifo.pop();
384: 		}
385: 		
386: 		/* read response */
387: 		if (!r_fifo.empty()) {
388: 			axi_r_txn &txn = r_fifo.front();
389: 			
390: 			r0_fifo.push(txn);
391: 			r_fifo.pop();
392: 		} else {
393: 			axi_r_txn txn;
394: 			
395: 			txn.rvalid = 0;
396: 			txn.rid = 0;
397: 			txn.rlast = 0;
398: 			for (int i = 0; i < AXI_WIDTH / 32; i++) {
399: 				txn.rdata[i] = 0xAAAAAAAA;
400: 			}
401: 			
402: 			r0_fifo.push(txn);
403: 		}
404: 
405: 		*dla.r_rvalid = 0;
406: 		if (*dla.r_rready && !r0_fifo.empty()) {
407: 			axi_r_txn &txn = r0_fifo.front();
408: 			
409: 			*dla.r_rvalid = txn.rvalid;
410: 			*dla.r_rid = txn.rid;
411: 			*dla.r_rlast = txn.rlast;
412: 			for (int i = 0; i < AXI_WIDTH / 32; i++) {
413: 				dla.r_rdata[i] = txn.rdata[i];
414: 			}
415: 			
416: 			if (txn.rvalid)
417: 				printf("(%lu) %s: read push: id %d, da %08x %08x %08x %08x\n",
418: 					ticks, name, txn.rid, txn.rdata[0], txn.rdata[1], txn.rdata[2], txn.rdata[3]);
419: 			
420: 			r0_fifo.pop();
421: 		}
422: 		
423: 		/* write response */
424: 		*dla.b_bvalid = 0;
425: 		if (*dla.b_bready && !b_fifo.empty()) {
426: 			*dla.b_bvalid = 1;
427: 			
428: 			axi_b_txn &txn = b_fifo.front();
429: 			*dla.b_bid = txn.bid;
430: 			b_fifo.pop();
431: 		}
432: 	}
433: };

435: class TraceLoader {
436: 	enum axi_opc {
437: 		AXI_LOADMEM,
438: 		AXI_DUMPMEM
439: 	};
440: 
441: 	struct axi_op {
442: 		axi_opc opcode;
443: 		uint32_t addr;
444: 		uint32_t len;
445: 		const uint8_t *buf;
446: 		const char *fname;
447: 	};
448: 	std::queue<axi_op> opq;
449: 	
450: 	CSBMaster *csb;
451: 	AXIResponder<uint64_t> *axi_dbb, *axi_cvsram;
452: 	
453: 	int _test_passed;
454: 
455: public:
456: 	enum stop_type {	
457: 		TRACE_CONTINUE = 0,
458: 		TRACE_AXIEVENT,
459: 		TRACE_WFI
460: 	};
461: 
462: 	TraceLoader(CSBMaster *_csb, AXIResponder<uint64_t> *_axi_dbb, AXIResponder<uint64_t> *_axi_cvsram) {
463: 		csb = _csb;
464: 		axi_dbb = _axi_dbb;
465: 		axi_cvsram = _axi_cvsram;
466: 		_test_passed = 1;
467: 	}
468: 	
469: 	void load(const char *fname) {
470: 		int fd;
471: 		fd = open(fname, O_RDONLY);
472: 		if (fd < 0) {
473: 			perror("open(trace file)");
474: 			abort();
475: 		}
476: 	
477: 		unsigned char cmd;
478: 		int rv;
479: #define VERILY_READ(p, n) do { if (read(fd, (p), (n)) != (n)) { perror("short read"); abort(); } } while(0)
480: 		do {
481: 			VERILY_READ(&cmd, 1);
482: 			
483: 			switch (cmd) {
484: 			case 1:
485: 				printf("CMD: wait\n");
486: 				csb->ext_event(TRACE_WFI);
487: 				break;
488: 			case 2: {
489: 				uint32_t addr;
490: 				uint32_t data;
491: 			
492: 				VERILY_READ(&addr, 4);
493: 				VERILY_READ(&data, 4);
494: 				printf("CMD: write_reg %08x %08x\n", addr, data);
495: 				csb->write(addr, data);
496: 				break;
497: 			}
498: 			case 3: {
499: 				uint32_t addr;
500: 				uint32_t mask;
501: 				uint32_t data;
502: 				
503: 				VERILY_READ(&addr, 4);
504: 				VERILY_READ(&mask, 4);
505: 				VERILY_READ(&data, 4);
506: 				printf("CMD: read_reg %08x %08x %08x\n", addr, mask, data);
507: 				csb->read(addr, mask, data);
508: 				break;
509: 			}
510: 			case 4: {
511: 				uint32_t addr;
512: 				uint32_t len;
513: 				uint8_t *buf;
514: 				uint32_t namelen;
515: 				char *fname;
516: 				axi_op op;
517: 				
518: 				VERILY_READ(&addr, 4);
519: 				VERILY_READ(&len, 4);
520: 				buf = (uint8_t *)malloc(len);
521: 				VERILY_READ(buf, len);
522: 				
523: 				VERILY_READ(&namelen, 4);
524: 				fname = (char *) malloc(namelen+1);
525: 				VERILY_READ(fname, namelen);
526: 				fname[namelen] = 0;
527: 				
528: 				op.opcode = AXI_DUMPMEM;
529: 				op.addr = addr;
530: 				op.len = len;
531: 				op.buf = buf;
532: 				op.fname = fname;
533: 				opq.push(op);
534: 				csb->ext_event(TRACE_AXIEVENT);
535: 				
536: 				printf("CMD: dump_mem %08x bytes from %08x -> %s\n", len, addr, fname);
537: 				break;
538: 			}
539: 			case 5: {
540: 				uint32_t addr;
541: 				uint32_t len;
542: 				uint8_t *buf;
543: 				axi_op op;
544: 				
545: 				VERILY_READ(&addr, 4);
546: 				VERILY_READ(&len, 4);
547: 				buf = (uint8_t *)malloc(len);
548: 				VERILY_READ(buf, len);
549: 				
550: 				op.opcode = AXI_LOADMEM;
551: 				op.addr = addr;
552: 				op.len = len;
553: 				op.buf = buf;
554: 				opq.push(op);
555: 				csb->ext_event(TRACE_AXIEVENT);
556: 				
557: 				printf("CMD: load_mem %08x bytes to %08x\n", len, addr);
558: 				break;
559: 			}
560: 			case 0xFF:
561: 				printf("CMD: done\n");
562: 				break;
563: 			default:
564: 				printf("unknown command %c\n", cmd);
565: 				abort();
566: 			}
567: 		} while (cmd != 0xFF);
568: 		
569: 		close(fd);
570: 	}
571: 	
572: 	void axievent() {
573: 		if (opq.empty()) {
574: 			printf("extevent with nothing in the queue?\n");
575: 			abort();
576: 		}
577: 		
578: 		axi_op &op = opq.front();
579: 		
580: 		AXIResponder<uint64_t> *axi;
581: 		if ((op.addr & 0xF0000000) == 0x50000000)
582: 			axi = axi_cvsram;
583: 		else if ((op.addr & 0xF0000000) == 0x80000000)
584: 			axi = axi_dbb;
585: 		else {
586: 			printf("AXI event to bad offset\n");
587: 			abort();
588: 		}
589: 		
590: 		switch(op.opcode) {
591: 		case AXI_LOADMEM: {
592: 			const uint8_t *buf = op.buf;
593: 			
594: 			printf("AXI: loading memory at 0x%08x\n", op.addr);
595: 			while (op.len) {
596: 				axi->write(op.addr, *buf);
597: 				buf++;
598: 				op.addr++;
599: 				op.len--;
600: 			}
601: 			break;
602: 		}
603: 		case AXI_DUMPMEM: {
604: 			int fd;
605: 			const uint8_t *buf = op.buf;
606: 			int matched = 1;
607: 			
608: 			printf("AXI: dumping memory to %s\n", op.fname);
609: 			fd = creat(op.fname, 0666);
610: 			if (!fd) {
611: 				perror("creat(dumpmem)");
612: 				break;
613: 			}
614: 			while (op.len) {
615: 				uint8_t da = axi->read(op.addr);
616: 				write(fd, &da, 1);
617: 				if (da != *buf && matched) {
618: 					printf("AXI: FAIL: mismatch at memory address %08x (exp 0x%02x, got 0x%02x), and maybe others too\n", op.addr, *buf, da);
619: 					matched = 0;
620: 					_test_passed = 0;
621: 				}
622: 				buf++;
623: 				op.addr++;
624: 				op.len--;
625: 			}
626: 			close(fd);
627: 			
628: 			if (matched)
629: 				printf("AXI: memory dump matched reference\n");
630: 			break;
631: 		}
632: 		default:
633: 			abort();
634: 		}
635: 		
636: 		opq.pop();
637: 	}
638: 	
639: 	int test_passed() {
640: 		return _test_passed;
641: 	}
642: };

### 4. Data Flow Summary (for Verilog signal mapping)

The key internal dataflow path through the convolution pipeline is:

```
CDMA --[cdma2buf_dat_wr/cdma2buf_wt_wr]--> CBUF --[sc2buf_dat_rd/sc2buf_wt_rd/sc2buf_wmb_rd]--> CSC
CSC  --[sc2mac_dat_a/sc2mac_dat_b/sc2mac_wt_a/sc2mac_wt_b]--> CMAC --[mac2accu]--> CACC
CACC --[cacc2sdp]--> SDP --[sdp2pdp]--> PDP
```

CSC provides back-pressure credit to CACC via `accu2sc_credit`.

CDMA and CSC handshake data/weight buffer info via `dat_up_cdma2sc`/`dat_up_sc2cdma` and `wt_up_cdma2sc`/`wt_up_sc2cdma`.

All DMA-capable modules (CDMA, SDP, PDP, CDP, BDMA, RBK) use MCIF (DRAM) and CVIF (CVSRAM) for memory access. Each has paired `_rd_req`/`_rd_rsp` and `_wr_req`/`_wr_rsp` channels. The write response is a simple `bool` (sc_in for consumers, sc_out for MCIF/CVIF).

All modules receive CSB configuration requests via `csb2xx_req` and respond via `xx2csb_resp`. The CSB master dispatches incoming host requests and collects responses from all sub-modules.

## Supporting Files Summary

**`/app/cmod/include/NV_NVDLA_conv_base.h`**: Defines the SystemC base class for the NV_NVDLA_conv module (the combined CDMA+CSC+CMAC pipeline). It exposes TLM sockets for CSB requests, data output, credit-based flow control (act_data_debit, weight_debit, weight_mask_debit), and RAM read interfaces (act_addr, weight_addr, weight_mask_addr). This is the interface between the conv pipeline sub-modules.

**`/app/cmod/include/nvdla_container_number_32_bit_width_32_iface.h`**: Defines `nvdla_container_number_32_bit_width_32_t` -- a struct with a 32-bit mask, an array of 32x `sc_uint<32>` data words, and a last flag. Used for batched data transfers (e.g., 32 entries of 32-bit data).

**`/app/cmod/include/nvdla_container_number_8_bit_width_32_iface.h`**: Defines `nvdla_container_number_8_bit_width_32_t` -- a struct with an 8-bit mask, an array of 8x `sc_uint<32>` data words, and a last flag. Used for smaller batched transfers (e.g., 8 entries of 32-bit data).

---

## Common Register Patterns Across Modules

1. **Producer/Consumer model**: All convolution-pipeline modules (CDMA, CSC, CMAC_A, CACC, SDP_RDMA, SDP, PDP_RDMA, PDP, CDP_RDMA, CDP, RBK) have `S_STATUS` and `S_POINTER` registers at offsets 0x00 and 0x04. The `S_POINTER` register uses bit[0] for PRODUCER and bit[16] for CONSUMER. The `S_STATUS` uses bit[16] for STATUS_0 and bit[17] for STATUS_1.

2. **D_OP_ENABLE**: Always at the boundary between single-entity (S_) and dual-entity (D_) registers. Writing OP_EN=1 triggers operation. The producer pointer selects which shadow group receives the write.

3. **D_MISC_CFG**: Common in CDMA, CSC, CMAC_A, CACC, RBK. Contains CONV_MODE and precision fields.

4. **4KB address space**: Each module occupies a 4KB address space. The lower 12 bits (`reg_addr & 0xFFF`) are the module-relative offset.

The most practical approach is to write the RTL from scratch, focusing on the critical modules first. However, given the massive scope (266 files), I need to be strategic about what to implement and in what order.

Let me think about what each test needs:

1. **sanity3** - Multi-layer sequence with data checking - needs full pipeline
2. **sanity3_cvsram** - Same but with CVSRAM - needs full pipeline + CVIF
3. **conv_8x8_fc_int16** - 8×8 FC conv, INT16 - needs CDMA+CSC+CMAC+CACC+SDP
4. **googlenet_conv2_3x3_int16** - GoogLeNet conv, INT16 - needs full conv pipeline
5. **pdp_max_pooling_int16** - PDP max pooling - needs conv pipeline + PDP
6. **sdp_relu_int16** - SDP ReLU - needs conv pipeline + SDP
7. **cc_alexnet_conv5_relu5_int16_dtest_cvsram** - AlexNet conv5+relu5 - needs conv pipeline + SDP + CVSRAM

All tests need: CAR, GLB, CSB_MASTER, NOCIF (MCIF+CVIF), CDMA, CBUF, CSC, CMAC, CACC, and at minimum SDP or PDP.

This is an enormous amount of work. Let me focus on getting the structure right and implementing a working pipeline.

6. CDMA - convolution DMA

9. CACC - convolution accumulator
10. SDP - single data path
11. PDP - planar data path
12. CDP - channel data path
13. BDMA - bridge DMA
14. RUBIK - data reshape
15. APB2CSB - APB to CSB bridge
16. Retiming - pipeline registers
17. Top-level - NV_nvdla.v

524: input RET_EN;
525: input RE, WE, CLK_R, CLK_W, IDDQ;
526: input [4:0] RA, WA;

532: 
533: //State point clobering signals:
534: 
535:     wire output_valid = ~(clobber_x | (|SLEEP_EN));
536:     wire clamp_o = SLEEP_EN[7] | RET_EN;
537: 
538: 	//common part for write
539:     wire clk_w_iddq = CLK_W & ~IDDQ & ~clamp_o;
540: 	reg we_lat;
541: 	always @(*) begin
542: 		if (!clk_w_iddq & !clobber_flops) begin
543: 			we_lat  <=  WE; // spyglass disable W18, IntClock
544: 		end
545: 	end
546: 
547:     // weclk with posedge 1 dly | negedge 2 dly	
548:     wire weclk, weclk_d0, weclk_d1, weclk_d2;
549:     assign weclk_d0 = clk_w_iddq & we_lat & ~clobber_flops & ~clobber_array;
550:     assign #1 weclk_d1 = weclk_d0;
551:     assign #1 weclk_d2 = weclk_d1;
552:     assign weclk = weclk_d1 | weclk_d2; // spyglass disable GatedClock
553: 
554:     // wadclk with posedge 0 dly | negedge 3 dly	
555:     wire wadclk, wadclk_d0, wadclk_d1, wadclk_d2, wadclk_d3;
556:     assign wadclk_d0 = clk_w_iddq & we_lat;
557:     assign #1 wadclk_d1 = wadclk_d0;
558:     assign #1 wadclk_d2 = wadclk_d1;
559:     assign #1 wadclk_d3 = wadclk_d2;
560:     assign wadclk = wadclk_d0 | wadclk_d1 | wadclk_d2 | wadclk_d3;  
561: 
562:     // wdclk with posedge 0 dly | negedge 3 dly
563:     wire wdclk, wdclk_d0, wdclk_d1, wdclk_d2, wdclk_d3;
564:     assign wdclk_d0 = clk_w_iddq & we_lat;
565:     assign #1 wdclk_d1 = wdclk_d0;
566:     assign #1 wdclk_d2 = wdclk_d1;
567:     assign #1 wdclk_d3 = wdclk_d2;
568:     assign wdclk = wdclk_d0 | wdclk_d1 | wdclk_d2 | wdclk_d3;  
569: 
570:     reg [4:0] wa_lat;
571: 	always @(*) begin
572: 		if (!wadclk & !clobber_flops) begin
573: 			wa_lat  <=  WA; // spyglass disable W18, IntClock
574: 		end
575: 	end
576: 
577: 	reg [31:0] wd_lat;
578: 	always @(*) begin
579: 		if (!wdclk & !clobber_flops) begin
580: 			wd_lat  <= WD; // spyglass disable W18, IntClock
581: 		end
582: 	end
583: 
584: 	//common part for read
585: 	reg re_lat;
586: 	always @(*) begin
587: 		if (!CLK_R & !clobber_flops) begin
588: 			re_lat <=  RE; // spyglass disable W18, IntClock
589: 		end
590: 	end
591: 
592:     // reclk with posedge 1 dly | negedge 0 dly
593:     wire reclk, reclk_d0, reclk_d1;
594:     assign reclk_d0 = CLK_R & ~IDDQ & re_lat & ~clamp_o;
595:     assign #1 reclk_d1 = reclk_d0;
596:     assign reclk = reclk_d0 & reclk_d1; // spyglass disable GatedClock
597: 
598:     // radclk with posedge 0 dly | negedge 1 dly

600:     assign radclk_d0 = CLK_R & ~IDDQ & re_lat & ~clamp_o;
601:     assign #1 radclk_d1 = radclk_d0;
602:     assign radclk = radclk_d0 | radclk_d1;  
603: 
604: 	reg [4:0] ra_lat;
605: 	always @(*) begin
606: 		if (!radclk & !clobber_flops) begin
607: 			ra_lat <=  RA; // spyglass disable W18, IntClock
608: 		end
609: 	end
610: 	
611: 	wire [31:0] dout;
612: 	assign RD = clamp_o ? 32'b0 : (output_valid ? dout : 32'bx); //spyglass disable STARC-2.10.1.6
